page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes right side (Scripture references beside the lines near the foot).

main_text.p: Siue enim veluti ipsam adorantes Mariam ipsi offerunt collyridem siue placentam, vana ista mulieres, siue pro ipsa offerre conantur prædictam hanc putidam oblationem, tota res stolida est & aliena & ex dæmonum motu fraus & impostura. Quo vero non longius extendam sermonem sufficient nobis relata, Maria in honore sit: Dominus adoretur. Hactenus Epiphanius ante mille ducentos annos Mariolatriam & Costeri societatem & religionem damnauit.
main_text.head: CAPVT I.
Interim an in reliquis veritatis scopum attigeris melius, videamus.
COSTERVS.
main_text.p: ÆTERVM, quo fructuosius sodales cum id genus hominibus versentur, duo præmittenda videntur; quorum alterum ad eos cognoscendos, alterum ad modum cum iis congrediendi pertinet. Vtrumque enim subinde magnam requirit industriam, dum angelus Satanæ se transfigurat in angelum lucis: & sermo hæreticorum serpit ut cancer.2.Cor.11.14.2.Tim.2.17.

page.notes: Drop cap "C" of "Cæterum" read as the initial; the marginal references are printed beside the last lines. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
